notes.title: Patch 1.07 is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31709063/0d12b65c7ba223c9afd8b6f2020020603df0bbc9.png[/img]

A new update for TT Isle of Man is now available to download, version 1.07 is bringing the following changes:

[h1]General fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Xbox controllers now work properly for Steam Beta version users.
[/list]

While this new version solves this specific issue, the triggers vibrations can experience some problems, this will be addressed [b]soon[/b].

Thank you for your support and understanding.

notes.title: Patch 1.05 is live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31709063/65c218e842bc1d6a3ad23f0ce0085fb7b282284b.png[/img]

Hi guys,
As promised, the new patch is now live on PC!

You can find the full patch notes below: 

[u]General fixes:[/u]
[list][*]Fixed a crash occasionally occurring when playing against a sidecar ghost.
[*]Fixed a bug that could display a wrong time in the leaderboard.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused ghosts to not correctly upload after a race.
[*]Fixed a crash at the end of the credits screen.
[*]The timer will no longer be displayed during a race after being deactivated in the options.[/list]


Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Patch 1.04 (fixes & sidecar DLC content)
notes.notes:
With the release of the “Sidecar Thrill” DLC comes a brand new patch, fixing various crashes and glitches that have been reported by the community.
You can find the full patch notes below. 

[h1]General improvements and fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added sidecar DLC content
[*]Fixed several collision glitches on the Snaefell Mountain track 
[*]Fixed small undesired elevations on several fantasy tracks (for example, old Blair Forest and Hertfordshire)
[*]Fixed a crash which occurred when changing sections on the Snaefell Mountain Course
[*]Updated fmod version to fix a sound bug which could cause random crashes
[/list]

As always, your feedback is greatly appreciated, so don’t hesitate to share it with us so we can take it into consideration in the future.

notes.title: TT Patch 1.02: controller support
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31709063/bd8741e75ea2ab34c179c813f7451f08bedf3745.png[/img]

Hey everyone!
We have rolled out a new Patch addressing controllers support:
[list][*]Steam Controller and PS4 gamepads are now fully supported
[*]Steam Controller, Xbox and PS4 controllers now work with Steam Link[/list]

If you're still experiencing issues, be sure to post in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/626610/discussions/1/]tech support forum[/url].

Thanks again for your help!

notes.title: TT Patch 1.01 is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31709063/59dde3945480781f6deb07f470dc2bd4d34cdab6.png[/img]

We’ve just released a patch for the PC version of TT.
You can find the full changelog below.

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Trigger feedback for Xbox gamepads are now available on PC
[*]Updated pilot’s animations
[*]In the options menu, "resolution" and "refresh rate" values are now associated with the type of screen selected[/list]

[b]AI[/b]
[list][*]AI pilots are less likely to collide with other vehicles
[*]Increased very slightly AI brake skill 
[*]Adjusted AI turn skill to avoid being too slow during a turn[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed several crashes
[*]Fixed several achievements that did not unlock
[*]In career mode, fixed Tourist Trophy events that did not appear properly
[*]Fixed some achievements that did not unlock properly
[*]We thank you again for your continued feedback and support.[/list]

Thank you for your continued feedback and support!
